script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: Saying people will agree to a lot suggests the submission was voluntary. The verse does not say that.
The light line about inheriting a blessing makes light of a passage about sin and punishment.
No one to deliver them does not establish that nobody is on the way. The verse also does not give that as the reason the prayer turns to the LORD.
The verse says there is no one to deliver them; it does not say whether anyone is coming.
The playful comparison between his oven and their fever makes light of suffering from hunger.
The passage does not say Mount Zion was full before or that it is now quiet.
The verse says foxes patrol Mount Zion, not that foxes are the only ones there.
The passage does not say everything else in the city fell apart.
